text_block_list.text:
Thanks to the kindness of Fusaichi Pandora's
parents, we came to have fun at a warm resort.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
We're here!
Let's go take photos right away♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"It's fine, it's fine!
Come on, over this way♪"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Found it, found it! Right here~!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: They say that when the sun hits this cove just right, it casts a heart-shaped shadow on the sea♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Plus dolphins are coming too!
Man, it's seriously so sparkly! I'm totally taking pics!

Fusaichi Pandora compares the scene to photos on social media.
Indeed, it seems to have been a prime spot for taking picture-perfect shots.
choice_data_list: Then let's wait until the shadow and the dolphin line up!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Yaaay♡
—30 minutes later.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I'm bored.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Because the dolphins aren't showing up at all. And the heart shadow looks super lame, too... Waiting around is so boring.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Whatever, let's just... do something else.
Like eating ice cream.

It was a sight you couldn't see unless various natural conditions aligned.
Waiting for it was no easy task either.
choice_data_list: Finding a different way to enjoy it could work too, huh...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
We're here!
Let's go take photos right away♡
choice_data_list: (...She must have been looking forward to this for a while.)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...?
What's up? Aren't you coming?
choice_data_list: I'll wait a little longer over there.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh? ...Come on, that's enough.
Even if you wait around like that, there's no guarantee you can take it.
choice_data_list: Get some rest, Pandora. I'll let you know once I spot it.

text_block_list.text:
"...That look of pure anticipation on their face when going to take photos.
I just can't forget it."

"She might forget all about it right away with some ice cream.
But what if... at the end of the day, she looks back at the photos and lets out a small sigh?"

If you ever find yourself muttering,
"Man, I really wish I could've seen it"—
choice_data_list: I don't want to taint what should be a happy memory.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: —...Ho-huh?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: "...Huh? What?"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: You're holding on for a reason like that...?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Oh man.
Ehehe, that's so crazy...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Jeez, is she like, crazy in love with me or what~?!

As I gazed at the sea,
Fusaichi Pandora came jogging back.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Well, if you insist, I'll keep you company♡
Ehehe~♪

—Even as time passed, she remained in high spirits for some reason.
The two of them stood side-by-side, continuing to watch over the sea...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hey, Trainer!
The ocean just sparkled!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"The dolphins are here~~!
So cuuuuute♡"

Not only that! The setting sun is shining in,
making the heart in the cove stand out clearly!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Waaa~~...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right! A photo! I'll set the timer!
Trainer, get in front!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Jump on three!
One, twooooo, three!

Startled by the sudden cue,
I time my step and kick off the ground—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Awww♡
No way! That's so emotional♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Nhehe~ Trainer, aren't you glad~?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Grant me the "thing I want to see"♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"When you said you were gonna hold your ground,
I was like, 'Are you for real?!' though!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Well, maybe once in a while,
I could go along with you~?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Spoiled-little-brat~☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Well then, we saw something lucky!
Wanna head home~?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Wait, we haven't eaten any ice cream yet!
Let's get some, okay?

I had things I wanted to say.
But seeing how happy she was,
none of it seemed to matter anymore.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"...So pretty.
Ehehe."

—Night.
Just as I was about to go to sleep, a LANE notification popped up.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Here's a photo from today!
Feel free to use it as your wallpaper."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Fank you, Trainer♡"
...and send!
